Annual Performance Review 2023-24

Overview

The Electricity Department reduced its aggregate technical and commercial (AT&C) losses from 14.2 per cent to 12.9 per cent in 2023-24. Collection efficiency rose to 98 per cent. The Department commissioned two new 33/11 kV substations at Verna and Tuem and replaced 1,850 km of bare conductor with aerial bunched cable.

Customer service

The Department received 41,326 complaints, of which 96 per cent were resolved within the standard time. The new call centre handled most of them. Smart meters were installed for 52,000 consumers under the RDSS (Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme), and prepaid billing was introduced for government offices.

Finance

Revenue from the sale of power was ₹2,846 crore, against a cost of supply of ₹3,112 crore. The gap of ₹266 crore was met by a subsidy from the State Government. The Department's employee costs rose by 6 per cent.
